Where to Buy
Powering the Next Generation of Workstations
Intel® Arc™ Pro B-Series enables new classes of professional workloads as Al, data, and advanced visualization reshape workstations.
The power to scale, locally
Combine the power and memory of multiple GPUs to execute Al models in Linux that take 100+ GB of VRAM.
Seamless Support Across Multiple GPUs
Multi-GPU Al support enables larger models, faster processing, and higher-quality outputs.
Keep More Data Local
Run inference directly on your workstation to shorten iteration cycles and maintain data privacy.
Designed Around How Professionals Work
Motion Designers
Deliver high-quality visuals faster with Al-powered rendering and effects.
Animators
Accelerate 2D/3D workflows with responsive, Al-simplified creative tools.
Architects
Gain seamless responsiveness and performance in complex architectural tools.
Developers
Build and test large models locally with private, fast iteration.
Engineers
Speed up complex visualizations and precise linework in CAD tools.
Product Designers
Create persuasive 3D models with realistic ray-traced lighting effects & textures.
Powering Advanced Al and Pro Workflows
High-Capacity Memory
Supports large Al models and complex datasets.
XMX AI Engines for Acceleration
Boost Al-driven creative applications and execute advanced Al models.
Next-Generation Xe Architecture
Optimized for Al and professional workloads.
Driver Support, Tuned to Your Workflow
Built for professional stability and performance.
Scalable GPU Support
Expand performance with multi-GPU configurations.
Dedicated Ray Tracing Units for Photorealism
Enable realistic lighting and reflections.
Robust Linux Drivers
For Al deployments across development environments.
Xe Media Engine for Faster Video Workflows
Advanced encode and decode support.
Intel® Arc™ Pro B65 GPU
Enables faster execution of advanced Al models, supports scalable multi-GPU deployments, and delivers workstation-grade reliability-ideal for users pushing the limits of Al, rendering, and high-end creative applications.
1GPU Peak TOPS (trillions of operations per second) represents the peak throughput when running XMX workloads with INT8 datatype and dense models. Performance may vary based on configuration.

Al features may require software purchase, subscription or enablement by a software or platform provider, or may have specific configuration or compatibility requirements. Data privacy advantages refer to non-cloud-based Al apps. Learn more at intel.com/AIPC.
